summary.text: Austin Foss is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 44 (Fargo) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Austin Foss's service as "House since 2025". The member page lists Austin Foss's committee assignments as including the Energy and Natural Resources and the Finance and Taxation standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Austin Foss's occupation as Architect, Entrepreneur.
It lists education as BA, MA, Architecture, NDSU.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: American Institute of Architects; Fargo Downtown Neighborhood Association.
Austin Foss is listed as married to Ryan.
